controls.label: Color
controls.qualification: Colour from a measured spectrum of the star (Pulkovo catalogue). The disc is unresolved; its darker edge follows a model limb-darkening law, not a measurement.
controls.notes: The colour of Deneb's spectrum as the Pulkovo spectrophotometric catalogue measured it from the ground, 320-1080 nm at 10 nm resolution. No resolved image of the surface is cast; the display axis is celestial north, a convention.

resources.label: Research
